title: Standard Chartered launches four Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
FILE PHOTO: Standard Chartered launches its Signature CIO Funds from GIFT City, expanding international wealth solutions for affluent clients in India. | Photo Credit: PETER NICHOLLS

Standard Chartered on Thursday announced the launch of its wealth solutions from India’s Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT City), expanding the international investment solutions available to its affluent clients in India.

The bank is launching its Signature CIO Funds, a suite of four funds that bring its Chief Investment Office (CIO) investment strategies to clients through diversified, multi-asset portfolios, with additional wealth solutions to follow over time, an official release stated here. Developed in partnership with Amundi Asset Management and SBI Funds International (IFSC) Limited, the Signature CIO Funds are designed to cater to different investment objectives and risk appetites, investing across global equities, bonds, commodities, liquid alternatives and cash.

The launch enables the Bank to expand its suite of wealth solutions, leveraging its international network and wealth capabilities to meet clients’ evolving needs. Standard Chartered was the first foreign bank to commence operations in GIFT City in 2020 and currently provides a comprehensive suite of banking services to corporate and institutional clients.
